1. (Currently amended) An association method, comprising:
identifying candidate file sets from a plurality of application files, each candidate file set including a cluster of related but unrecognized application files;
presenting content indicative of each of the candidate file sets; and
associating an application with application files of one of the candidate file sets according to a detected selection of the content indicative of the one of the candidate file set, wherein the association is performed based on __quantitative relationships among the application files within the candidate file set__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the candidate file sets include at least one of a frequent file set based on __frequency of co-occurrence__, a common application package file set, a common version file set, and a common directory file set.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein identifying candidate file sets comprises constructing a frequent pattern tree from the found application files and identifying the candidate file sets that are frequent file sets from the frequent pattern tree, wherein __the frequent pattern tree is constructed based on analyzing co-occurrence patterns of application files across multiple computing devices__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein identifying candidate file sets comprises identifying candidate file sets having a support exceeding a predetermined threshold support, wherein __support is measured as a percentage of computing devices in which the candidate file set appears__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein identifying candidate file sets comprises identifying candidate file sets of sizes exceeding a predetermined threshold size, wherein __size is determined by the number of application files within each candidate file set__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein, for each identified candidate file set, the content presented for that candidate file set is indicative of at least one of a support and a size of the candidate file set, __and wherein the support and size information is calculated from analysis of the plurality of application files across multiple computing devices__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the plurality of application files is a first plurality, the method comprising:
generating a rule based on the association between the application and its corresponding candidate file set, wherein __the rule specifies the quantitative relationships and file characteristics that define the candidate file set__;
and
processing the rule to automatically associate unrecognized files of a second plurality of application files with the application, __wherein the processing comprises matching unrecognized files against the quantitative relationships specified in the rule__.

8. (Currently amended) A __non-transitory__ computer readable medium having __instructions stored thereon that, when executed by a processing resource, implement a system comprising:__ a file set engine configured to examine a plurality of unrecognized application files and identify candidate file sets from the plurality; __a__ presentation engine is configured to present content indicative of each identified candidate file set; and __an__ association engine is configured to detect a selection of content indicative of one of the candidate file sets and associate an application with an application file of that one of the candidate file sets, __wherein the file set engine identifies candidate file sets based on quantitative relationships among the application files__.

9. (Currently amended) The medium of claim 8, wherein the file set engine is configured to identify candidate file sets that include at least one of a frequent file set based on __frequency of co-occurrence__, a common application package file set, a common version file set, and a common directory file set.

10. (Currently amended) The medium of claim 8, wherein the file set engine is configured to construct a data structure representing quantitative information about frequent patterns found within the set of unrecognized files and identify the candidate file sets that are frequent file sets from the data structure, __wherein the data structure is constructed by analyzing co-occurrence patterns of application files across multiple computing devices__.

11. (Currently amended) The medium of claim 8, wherein the file set engine is configured to identify candidate file sets having a support exceeding a predetermined threshold, __wherein support is measured as a percentage of computing devices in which the candidate file set appears__.

12. (Currently amended) The medium of claim 8, wherein the file set engine is configured to identify candidate file sets of sizes exceeding a predetermined threshold, __wherein size is determined by the number of application files within each candidate file set__.

13. (Currently amended) The medium of claim 8, wherein, for each identified candidate file set, the presentation engine is configured to present content for that candidate file set that is indicative of at least one of a support and a file set size of the candidate file set, __and wherein the support and size information is calculated from analysis of the plurality of application files across multiple computing devices__.

14. (Currently amended) The medium of claim 8, wherein the plurality of application files is a first plurality, wherein the association engine is configured to generate a rule based on the association between the application and its corresponding candidate file set, __wherein the rule specifies the quantitative relationships and file characteristics that define the candidate file set__; and the system includes a recognition engine configured to process the rule to automatically associate unrecognized files of a second plurality of application files with the application, __wherein the processing comprises matching unrecognized files against the quantitative relationships specified in the rule__.

15. (Currently amended) A system comprising a processing resource and a non-transitory computer readable medium and instructions stored on the medium, wherein the instructions, when executed, cause the processing resource to implement a method, comprising:
examining a plurality of unrecognized application files of two or more computing devices to identify candidate file sets from the plurality, __wherein the identifying comprises analyzing quantitative relationships among the application files__;
presenting content indicative of each of the candidate file sets; and
associating an application with the application files of a given one of the candidate file sets according to a selection of the content indicative of that candidate file set, __wherein the association is based on the quantitative relationships among the application files within the candidate file set__.

16. (Currently amended) The system of claim 15, wherein the identified candidate file sets include at least one of a frequent file set based on __frequency of co-occurrence__, a common application package file set, a common version file set, and a common directory file set.

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 15, wherein examining comprises constructing a frequent pattern tree representing quantitative information about candidate patterns found within the set of unrecognized files and identifying the candidate file sets that are frequent file sets utilizing the frequent pattern tree, __wherein the frequent pattern tree is constructed by analyzing co-occurrence patterns of application files across multiple computing devices__.

18. (Currently amended) The system of claim 15, wherein identifying the candidate pattern sets comprises identifying candidate pattern sets having a support exceeding a first predetermined threshold and a size exceeding a second predetermined threshold, __wherein support is measured as a percentage of computing devices in which the candidate pattern set appears and size is determined by the number of application files within each candidate pattern set__.

19. (Currently amended) The system of claim 15, wherein, for each identified candidate pattern file set, the content presented for that candidate pattern set is indicative of at least one of a support and a file set size of the candidate pattern file set, __and wherein the support and size information is calculated from analysis of the plurality of application files across multiple computing devices__.

20. (Currently amended) The system of claim 15, wherein the plurality of application files is a first plurality and wherein the method further comprises:
generating a rule based on the association between the application and its associated candidate file set, __wherein the rule specifies the quantitative relationships and file characteristics that define the candidate file set__; and
processing the rule to automatically associate unrecognized files of a second plurality of application files with the application, __wherein the processing comprises matching unrecognized files against the quantitative relationships specified in the rule__, the unrecognized files corresponding to one or more files of the corresponding candidate file set.
